headline: Put Edifier speaker controls within reach
intro: Edifier Infrared turns selected Edifier speaker commands into Home Assistant controls through an infrared emitter. Choose the emitter and speaker model during setup, then use the media player and button entities to send the commands supported by that model.
highlights: Setup pairs an infrared emitter entity with a speaker model.
Media player controls include model-specific power, volume, and mute commands.
Some supported models also provide playback and track navigation commands.

flow.title: From setup to speaker control
stages: Use its available media player and button controls
